tgt: We were appalled and shocked by the incident.
src: 得知这一事件，我们感到大吃一惊。
mbart: We are greatly astonished to learn of this incident.
opus-mt: We were surprised to learn of the incident.

tgt: A family of yobs left their council house with £50,000 worth of damage after they were evicted for terrorising their neighbours.
src: 因恐吓邻居而遭驱逐的一户流氓家庭，在离开前对其所住廉租房进行了破坏，造成了50000英镑的损失。
mbart: A rogue family that was expelled over fears of intimidation from neighbours wrecked up its cheap apartment before leaving, causing damage of £50,000.
opus-mt: The family of rogues who had been evicted from their homes as a result of intimidation of their neighbours had destroyed their affordable rental accommodation before leaving, resulting in a loss of Pound50,000.

tgt: The Olympics achieved huge benefits for Stratford and the East End.
src: 奥运会使斯特拉特福德和东区受益匪浅。
mbart: The Olympics have done Stratford and the Eastern Territories a lot of good.
opus-mt: The Olympic Games would greatly benefit Stratford and Sector East.

tgt: Expanding the interpersonal relationship circle, more equal dialogue, avoiding social concerns are major reasons for us to be fascinated with online chat.
src: 扩大人际关系圈，更平等地对话，避免社交顾虑，才是我们越发深爱线上聊的主要原因。
mbart: Broadening the circle of relationships, engaging in more egalitarian dialogue, and avoiding social prejudice are among the key reasons why we communicate more deeply online.
opus-mt: Broadening the circle of relationships, more equitable dialogue and avoiding social concerns are the main reasons why we are talking more deeply in love.

tgt: From these factors, it is quite normal to have some fluctuations in some indicators. And such thing is expected.
src: 从这些因素来看，7月份部分指标出现波动也是很正常，也是在预期之中。
mbart: In light of these factors, fluctuations in some of the indicators released in July were both normal and expected.
opus-mt: In the light of these factors, fluctuations in some of the indicators in July were also normal and expected.
